Track 3 (chip). Ten small Verilog tasks, a compile/lint/simulation/SAT-miter checker, and a random-mutation hill-climbing repair baseline (9/20, 4/20, 4/20 repaired for 1/2/3 injected faults in 60 evaluations). The session agent passed all ten tasks first try, so feedback rounds are unmeasured; stated in the README. Renamed from chip-rtl-loop because a parallel run merged that slug first (closed #283 was my earlier claim); no code shared with it.
